For partners on a project with us. You put the devices out and send us the data. We process it, have experts check it, and send you the results. You don't need to install or code anything. Want to do some or all of it yourself? See [Do it yourself](do-it-yourself.qmd).

## What we do, and what you do

| | You | UKCEH |
|---|---|---|
| **Plan** | Tell us what you want to find out | Help design the survey; agree how the data will be used and shared |
| **Hardware** | Put the devices out, check batteries and cards | Advise on which devices and settings to use |
| **Sites** | Send us each device's details | Register each one as a deployment |
| **Data** | Upload photos or recordings | Store them safely, and process them with our AI models |
| **Checking** | | Experts check a sample of the results; regional species lists and noise filtering |
| **Results** | Tell us what you need | Species lists, reports, and often videos and soundscapes from your sites |

## The steps

::: {.steps}
1. **Agree a plan with us.** What you want to find out, which devices, how many sites, and for how long. We'll also agree how the data will be used and shared.
2. **Set up the hardware.** For AMI light traps and LepiSense, follow the [AMI system deployment guide](https://github.com/AMI-system/ami-system-deployment-guide). For sound recorders and bat detectors, follow the maker's instructions.
3. **Register each device.** Each device at each site is a *deployment*. Ask for one per device before you upload: see [Set up your sites](sites.qmd).
4. **Record.** Leave the devices running. Check batteries and memory cards as agreed.
5. **Send us your data.** Upload each deployment's photos or recordings: see [Send us your data](upload.qmd). We'll give you a username and password.
6. **We process it.** AI models find and name the moths, birds or bats, and experts check a sample of the results.
7. **Results.** You get species lists and a report, and often videos and soundscapes from your own sites.
8. **Tell people about it!** [Share your story](share-your-story.qmd) for this website.
:::

## Before you go out

Write these down for **each device**, on the day you set it up. They're needed to register the deployment and to read the results correctly:

| What | Example |
|---|---|
| Site name | Wytham Woods 1 |
| Where exactly | 51.7714, -1.3389 (in Google Maps, right-click the spot and click the numbers to copy them) |
| Device type and ID | AudioMoth 24F3191 |
| First and last day of recording | 1 May to 30 September 2027 |
| **What time the device's clock keeps** | UTC, or local time? AudioMoths keep UTC unless set otherwise |
| Anything unusual | moved after a storm, battery ran out in week 3, a cow knocked it over |

Take a photo of each device in place. It helps us, and it's great for your story.

## Who to ask

Email [alyduf@ceh.ac.uk](mailto:alyduf@ceh.ac.uk) with any question, at any step.
